GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Four Wide , Moved Up 3 Wide at 1200m, took 3 Wide Lead at 650m and led Two Wide by a length turning, joined Straightening Up and Headed soon after, faded a little in Straight # worked hard/ok

Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , Moved Up and joined Lead 550m, moved clear and led 0.75 Lengths turning, steered two lanes past centre of track Straightening Up and kept going in Straight # solid win

Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, Held Up home turn then shifted 3-4 Wide Straightening Up , not much pickup early in Straight then weakened over the final 175m # never a threat

Jumped okay, drifted back then moved into a Two Wide position with cover, trailed 4 Lengths Two Wide settling down, Drifted Back to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early/middle stages. Stewards questioned rider re settling further back than intended. Jockey stated that was the intention however from the Wide barrier he was unable to do So settling further back than intended.] # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly during the early and middle stages. When questioned regarding the gelding settling further back than intended, rider stated that it was his intention to settle in a forward position, however, from the wide barrier he was unable to do so and consequently settled further back than intended.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced keenly Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide midrace & improving 3 Wide from 600m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & challenged leaders @ 200m. Fought to lead @ 50m but grabbed near line. # Solid effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Approaching the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to be tested until shortly after straightening.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 7 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up and in Two Wide at 950m, held together much same to turn 4 Lengths Two Wide , steered Wide rounding turn, couldn;t come on in Straight # never a threat

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to trail Two Wide by 0.75 Lengths turning, steered a lane past centre of track Straightening Up and lost ground quickly in the run. (Blinkers OFF AGAIN) # weakened noticeably
Jumped Ok , Went Forward and sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden from the corner and weakened last 200m # on pace/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with a runner. Jockey stated that, in his opinion, Gaming may not have appreciated the heavy track conditions in conjunction with the weight impost in today’s event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , railed to Lead at 950m, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, Headed 75m from post # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1200m was carried in for a number of strides onto a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok settled down fifth Out Of Form the fence 4-5 Lengths (1000m), Wide before Turn , Straightened Up Further back & not doing much, faded Further (blinkers again) # did nothing
Jumped Ok , sat Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m, took over at the 200m and looked winner, fought tenaciously last 100m but just found one better, beat others easily # brave placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced keenly down the back straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Four Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths Four Wide turning, kept ccoming in Straight # wide, kept coming
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.
